cards.title: Pocket Park Tiny Bench Detail
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for adding a clearer pretend pocket-park place clue: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and ask the writer to draw one small park mark in the notebook margin before writing: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Find a plain park sentence and add one tiny bench, leaf, sign, or path clue beside it: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Sketch one pocket-park detail that belongs beside the notice board: ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The notice board stood in the park while ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Add one place detail before the action so the reader can picture the tiny park: ____________________.
cards.newLinePrompt: New line: Beside the notice board, ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the new detail show where the story is happening without naming the park again: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to the margin drawing and copy one detail word into the sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this card again with a new pretend park object in the margin: ____________________.

cards.title: Spoon Ferry Word Swap
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for swapping one plain harbor word for a sharper pretend word: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and place two pencils beside the draft line so the writer can choose one stronger word: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Underline one plain word about the spoon ferry, then trade it for a word with a clearer picture: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Write two ferry words in the notebook margin, then circle the livelier one: ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The spoon ferry moved across Lunchbox Harbor with ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Swap moved for a word like glided, bobbed, slid, or another fitting harbor word: ____________________.
cards.newLinePrompt: New line: The spoon ferry ____________________ across Lunchbox Harbor with ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the swapped word make the ferry easier to imagine: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle only one word in the margin and whisper it to the adult helper: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Try one more word swap on a new pretend lunchbox harbor sentence: ____________________.

cards.title: Acorn Avenue Helper Clue
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for adding a clear fictional helper clue in an errand office scene: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and ask the writer to choose one pretend office helper before changing the line: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Give the Acorn Avenue helper one action, tool, or habit that shows who they are: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Draw or list one helper clue, such as a stamp pad, tiny clipboard, or careful tap: ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The helper at Acorn Avenue said the errand was ready: ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Add one helper clue before the helper speaks so the character feels specific: ____________________.
cards.newLinePrompt: New line: The helper with ____________________ said the errand was ready: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Can someone tell something about the helper from the new clue: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Choose the helper clue by pointing, then write only the changed phrase: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Save this card for another pretend office helper with a different clue: ____________________.

cards.title: Seed Map Step Order
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for putting a fictional map-room moment into a clearer order: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and have the writer number three tiny margin boxes before revising the line: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Choose which map-room action happens first, next, and last, then rewrite the sentence in that order: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Number three seed-library steps in the margin: choose tag, unfold map, mark shelf: ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The map room helper marked the shelf after the tag and map were ready: ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Rewrite the line so the steps happen in the same order as your margin numbers: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Do the margin numbers match the new sentence order: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number the boxes only, then ask the adult to read the order aloud: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this card to reorder three steps in a new seed-library map scene: ____________________.

cards.title: Rain Gauge Railway Sound Line
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for adding a make-believe railway sound to a notebook draft: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and invite the writer to list two soft railway sounds in the margin before revising: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Add one sound that fits the rain-gauge train, station, ticket, rail, or tiny raindrop meter: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Write one railway sound word and one rain-gauge sound word in the margin: ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The Rain Gauge Railway train arrived at the little platform: ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Add one sound near the train arrival so the line feels more alive: ____________________.
cards.newLinePrompt: New line: With a ____________________, the Rain Gauge Railway train arrived at the little platform: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the added sound fit the gentle railway scene: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Tap the sound rhythm once on the paper, then write the sound word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Try this card again with a new pretend train sound in the margin: ____________________.
